quartz.notes: ffn_only ships; decode_segments8 capture failed in OPT-114

OPT-117_cuda_graphs.transferability: llama CUDA-graph capture of the decoded cgraph is the mechanism analogue; Quartz must capture its own scheduler FFN/attention/GDN launches, not import ggml graphs
OPT-117_cuda_graphs.actual_consumers: decode token body after graph capture

OPT-118_transfers.transferability: lazy host logits is a Quartz API change; llama keeps outputs on device until requested. Not a drop-in kernel.

OPT-119_activations.transferability: producer/consumer fusion is architecture-specific; Q8_1 vs internal Q8Block are not interchangeable
OPT-119_activations.actual_consumers: next projection / FFN down / KV append

quartz.physical_dtype: BF16 K/V, 16 layers, 4 KV heads, 256 width

OPT-120_packed_kv.transferability: llama fattn-vec can consume quantized K/V types in-registers. ds4 fp8_kv_quantize_row quantizes numerically then writes floats/half into raw cache (sizeof(float) storage); not a ready packed 8/4-bit resident cache. DeepSeek indexer/MoE is not Qwen 48-GDN/16-attention.
OPT-120_packed_kv.actual_consumers: prompt and decode attention over the live prefix

quartz.physical_dtype: Q4_K FFN, Q8_0 mixer, Q6_K output/attn out

ds4.notes: MXFP4 path preserves an already-MXFP4 source; requantizing this Q4_K_M artifact is a different approximation

OPT-121_weight_bytes.transferability: use llama/ds4 packed consumers as implementation references; do not relabel Q4_K bits as FP4
OPT-121_weight_bytes.actual_consumers: decode MMVQ and prompt MMQ of each role

bytes.candidate_plus_committed_capacity_note: decode swaps candidate/committed pointers; do not charge a full duplicate copy on every token unless measured

OPT-122_gdn_state.transferability: BF16/block-scaled recurrent storage is a Quartz numerical experiment; llama recurrent memory is a different layout

ranked.uncertainty: peak-bandwidth lower bound on weight time; L2 reuse and compute can only make wall longer, not shorter than this optimistic bound
ranked.rationale: streamed packed weights dominate compulsory decode bytes (10.183 ms at 1792 GB/s peak). Largest byte sink.

ranked.uncertainty: launch ms is GPU-idle leaf gaps this sitting when measured, else OPT-114 historical hypothesis; capture failure is not a measured graph loss
ranked.rationale: decode-segment graphs target launch/submit gaps. Bytes are not the savings; time is. Revalidate post113 gaps before treating OPT-114 ~11 ms/token as causal.

ranked.uncertainty: D128/D2048 KV peak bounds are small; 128K populated-cache reads are the material term. Capacity is not traffic.
ranked.rationale: KV peak bound D128 0.0047 ms, D2048 0.0749 ms, D131040 4.792 ms. Headline D128/D2048 must not be claimed from 128K capacity savings.

ranked.uncertainty: upper bound assumes one recurrent+conv pass per token with pointer-swap commit; extra rereads would raise the bound. Missing counter is not a measured zero.
ranked.rationale: GDN state 158859264 B resident; one-pass traffic peak bound 0.089 ms. Material only if measured amplification or long-scan traffic exceeds A/A resolution; otherwise no_material_opportunity remains open until OPT-122 measures it.

ranked.uncertainty: activation bytes are architecture-derived; fusion may not remove the compulsory dense weight sweep
ranked.rationale: decode activation traffic is far below weights. Prefill microbatch activations are the plausible slice.

ranked.uncertainty: PCIe byte bound is small; host-sample/D2H sync latency may exceed the copy bound and is not proven zero
ranked.rationale: logits D2H 993280 B/token (0.0006 ms at peak). Inventory, do not skip: sync and sampling can sit on the request critical path.

opt114_launch_historical.note: OPT-114 launch numbers are a hypothesis to revalidate on post113; wall minus leaf-event sums alone cannot identify causal removable overhead

proof_limit: diagnostics only: no production selector or kernel change; fresh post113_selected is the authenticated control; pinned llama cc83d7b4824f73cfdda4dfbb47ee39804f71b328 is the benchmark authority; 3 warmups plus 10 interleaved AB/BA pairs at P4096, D128, and D2048; long-context D8192/D32768/D131040+32 are separately labeled probes in a 131072-capacity session; 1792 GB/s is listed RTX 5090 peak, not observed application bandwidth; event unions distinguish GPU busy/idle, host overlap, sync and launch submission; no throughput or optimality claim
